title: 2026 race-gravel roundup: Chinese brands
notes: Community-compiled magazine-style roundup of Chinese race-gravel models (Winspace G5, Tavelo GROW, SEKA ExAero GR, INCOLOR Voyager, Quick Pro GR:ONE) plus the 2026 Giant Revolt. Each model page overlays the compiler's summary of tire clearance, size-M or size-54 stack and reach, chainstay, BB drop, wheelbase, chainring limit, UDH and storage on a brand photo. Values are secondary summaries; official specifications take precedence.

capture.scope: Archived public post; the selected photos were reviewed from the original files, which remain outside Git.
